description: The investigation primitives every domain shares: who and what is involved, what identifies them, what happened, and where. Domain packs extend these concepts; they do not change them.

concepts.name: Entity
concepts.description: Anything an investigation follows: a party, an account, a thing, a place or a digital object.

concepts.name: Agent
concepts.description: A party that can act: a person or an organization.

concepts.name: Person
concepts.description: A human being.

concepts.name: Organization
concepts.description: A company, group, agency or other body of people.

concepts.name: Account
concepts.description: An identity a party holds in a system: a user account, a service principal, a login.

concepts.name: Asset
concepts.description: Something owned or operated: a device, a cloud resource, a financial account, a vehicle.

concepts.name: Device
concepts.description: A machine: a host, server, laptop, phone or network appliance.

concepts.name: Resource
concepts.description: A resource in a cloud or service: a bucket, a database, a queue, a function.

concepts.name: FinancialAccount
concepts.description: An account that holds money: a bank account, a card, a wallet.

concepts.name: Location
concepts.description: A place: an address, a site, a region.

concepts.name: Artifact
concepts.description: A digital object that can be observed: a file, a process, a message, a piece of software.

concepts.name: Process
concepts.description: A program running on a device.

concepts.name: Software
concepts.description: A program or tool as published, not one running copy of it.

concepts.name: Identifier
concepts.description: A value that identifies an entity and links records about it: an address, a name, a number, a hash.

concepts.name: IPAddress
concepts.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address.

concepts.name: Email
concepts.description: An email address.

concepts.name: Domain
concepts.description: A DNS domain name.

concepts.name: Username
concepts.description: A name an account logs in with.

concepts.name: Event
concepts.description: Something that happened at a time and involved entities.

concepts.name: Observation
concepts.description: What a source saw, as it saw it, before anyone judged what it means.

relationships.name: member_of
relationships.description: The party belongs to the organization.

relationships.name: holds
relationships.description: The party holds or controls the account.

relationships.name: owns
relationships.description: The party owns or operates the asset.

relationships.name: acts_on
relationships.description: The account did something to, or with, the entity.

relationships.name: runs_on
relationships.description: The process runs on the device.

relationships.name: started
relationships.description: The process started the other process.

relationships.name: communicated_with
relationships.description: The entity sent to or received from the address.

relationships.name: located_at
relationships.description: The entity is at the location.

relationships.name: involves
relationships.description: The entity took part in the event.
